findings.summary: The prior final REJECT (rf-49b88ef6: request acceptance and call admission not atomic) is addressed. submit/next_goal_call/abort_unavailable_call now serialize their dedup->append->enqueue and resume/fence/mode/queue transitions under a per-kernel _request_lock, with three barrier-controlled offline regressions (test_concurrent_duplicate_submission_is_deduplicated, test_concurrent_distinct_submissions_keep_journal_and_queue_order, test_concurrent_next_goal_call_claims_exactly_once_without_losing_a_request).

Product consistency between work_head_commit e93c737cdd39d19e92e734a1c101c056f46c94d3 and subject_commit 8545dc97e11a02aca24681d7a78c0672391e27ac could not be mechanically git-diffed (read-only reviewer, no Git execution). Verified via the committed implement handoff: declared work_head_commit matches the supplied product commit and its verification_record records compileall exit 0 and pytest 70/70 against it. No product-tree divergence is evidenced.
